title: Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR) Calculator
subtitle: Estimate kidney function using the 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation. All calculations run in your browser — no data is sent or stored.
resultDisclaimer: This is an estimate for screening purposes only.
whatIsGfrText: Glomerular filtration rate (GFR) measures how well your kidneys filter waste from your blood.
howItWorksText: This tool uses the 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation, the current standard recommended by the National Kidney Foundation.
faq1a: It implements the same equation used by clinical laboratories and the National Kidney Foundation.
faq2a: To convert µmol/L to mg/dL, divide by 88.42.
faq3q: Can I use this for children?
faq3a: No. This equation is validated for adults aged 18 and older.
faq4q: Why is there no race input?
faq4a: The 2021 CKD-EPI equation removed the race coefficient.
disclaimer: Medical disclaimer: This calculator is for educational and screening purposes only.
footer: Runs entirely in your browser. No data is collected or transmitted.

stageMeanings.G3a: Mild to moderately decreased kidney function.
stageMeanings.G3b: Moderately to severely decreased kidney function.

interpretSuffix: This is a screening estimate — your doctor may order confirmatory tests.
alertFill: Please fill in age, sex, and serum creatinine.
alertAge: This calculator is validated for adults aged 18 and older.
